reviews_text:
Brian Cash – 5 Stars
I was recommended to Platinum Plumbing by a friend when I was having problems with a new fireplace. Justin came out, figured out the issue, and fixed it under warranty even though they didn’t sell me the fireplace. Because of that amazing service, I later had them replace my 30-year-old furnace. Justin answered all my questions, helped me choose the right unit, and the install was quick, clean, and done properly. Justin and his crew are honest, hardworking professionals. I highly recommend them.

Kerrie Spencer – 5 Stars
If you want a plumbing and heating crew that arrives on time, provides accurate estimates without surprises, does fantastic professional work, and cleans up afterward, Platinum is the team to call. The crew is absolutely wonderful.

Kim Z – 5 Stars
I’ve used Platinum several times for plumbing issues at my coffee house, and Justin and his team have been stellar. They’ve been quick to respond, even when it wasn’t convenient, helping us stay operational with temporary fixes before returning the next day for efficient permanent repairs. I recommend them wholeheartedly.

Curt C – 5 Stars
They do great work and are highly skilled with plumbing and heating repairs. When available, their workmanship is excellent and professional.

Greg Miller – 5 Stars
I was extremely impressed with the technician who drove from Regina to Indian Head to repair a gas heating stove. He was knowledgeable, professional, and did a fantastic job at a very fair price. Even with travel time included, it was absolutely worthwhile.

Kris Buhnai – 5 Stars
I’ve been using Platinum Plumbing and Heating for a couple of years and have been very impressed. They are prompt, professional, courteous, and work cleanly. I’ve never had any issues and would definitely recommend them.

Megan Negrych – 5 Stars
Definitely some of the nicest people around. They’re easy to contact with no phone trees or hassle, and every experience has been smooth and professional.

Tyler Zolinski – 5 Stars
Excellent company. They moved my washer and dryer hookups across the basement and gave me great options to choose from. While working, they identified issues left behind by the previous homeowner and fixed everything properly. Very knowledgeable and trustworthy.

Tyrell Brown – 5 Stars
My neighbor recommended them to install a gas line for my garage heater, and they were fantastic—clean work, professional, and courteous. I’ve since used them again for furnace diagnostics and had another great experience.

Crystal Morris – 5 Stars
Excellent service. Justin took my call first thing in the morning after our furnace quit overnight. He arrived as soon as possible, quickly assessed the problem, and was professional, friendly, and informative. Highly recommended and very reasonably priced.

Andrew Rink – 5 Stars
I’ve been using Platinum Plumbing and Heating for years and have always received outstanding service. They’re clean, efficient, and have the knowledge and tools needed for both new builds and renovations.

Brenda Baecker – 5 Stars
Even when they couldn’t directly help, they recommended another company that could assist with our gas fireplace. Very appreciated and professional.

George Zalusky – 5 Stars
Great people who do great work. They respond quickly and consistently provide excellent service.
